title.zh: 【Webull 将于 11 月向美国用户开放永续合约交易，首批涵盖比特币等加密资产】
title.en: 【Webull 将于 11 月向美国用户开放永续合约交易，首批涵盖比特币等加密资产】

current_state.zh: Webull will begin offering CFTC-regulated crypto perpetual futures, initially including Bitcoin, to eligible US customers starting in November through its existing futures accounts, with KalshiEX listing and Kalshi Klear clearing the products.
current_state.en: Webull will begin offering CFTC-regulated crypto perpetual futures, initially including Bitcoin, to eligible US customers starting in November through its existing futures accounts, with KalshiEX listing and Kalshi Klear clearing the products.
